card: Adds a standalone GitHub Actions CI workflow to build release packages via Guix for Linux, Windows, and macOS, test codesigning environments, and run test suites on the resulting binaries. This surfaces Guix breakages, missing dependencies, and release package regressions continuously instead of at release time. The change exports time-machine commit metadata for caching and substitute servers, downloads and installs Guix, and executes unit and functional tests against the produced binaries on native runners.
changed_since_previous: Added a test harness script and a matrix test job in the workflow to unpack the built release archives and run unit and functional tests on native Linux, Windows, and macOS runners.
evidence: Commit a340718c36: 'The regular Guix builds do not evaluate the codesign manifest, so missing imports and broken signing dependencies can go unnoticed until signing. Realize each signing target's environment before its main build to catch these failures without requiring signatures or signing keys.'

Commit 5f83028b4b: 'A Bitcoin Core-specific substitute server only needs to build the packages in the guix closure at a specific time machine commit... export it as a variable, so substitute builders (and anybody else) can re-use it by sourcing the prelude, instead of requiring error-prone command string parsing.'
problem: Guix build breakages, missing packaging imports, and broken signing dependencies are only detected when maintainers manually run Guix or prepare releases. Release packages produced by Guix are also not automatically verified by running their test suites on native target operating systems in CI.

risk.why: Mistakes are confined to CI configurations and Guix helper scripts, which could cause CI failures or wasted runner time without impacting node software or release binaries directly.

scope_notes: The branch currently contains three commits marked 'temp:' that extract Guix build packages and run test_bitcoin and test_runner.py on native GitHub runners.
summary: Adds a standalone GitHub Actions workflow to run Guix builds and tests for arm64-apple-darwin, x86_64-linux-gnu, and x86_64-w64-mingw32. Exports pinned Guix time-machine repository URL and commit variables from the common prelude for reuse in CI cache keys and substitute servers. Also validates codesign environments for Windows and macOS and runs functional and unit test suites on the produced Guix binaries across native runners.
